identifierPolicy.journalPosition: One-based position in this append-only snapshot; use with sourceEventHash.
identifierPolicy.sourceEventHash: Hash of the private chain row excluding its hash property, NOT the byte hash of the full JSONL line.
identifierPolicy.eventKey: Additional key present on newer events; earlier numeric IDs are preserved without renumbering.

limits: Tool-returned UI actions are not scenario PASS; assertions and PostgreSQL proofs remain separate.
Tool errors are attempted controls, not successful clicks or application failures.
Elapsed tool interaction time and wall span do not establish five hours of active testing.
No waiting, simulated UI clicks, historical profiles, provider payments or production operations added.
Raw observations and private request/SMTP/SQL material are omitted from this public export.
